ai_summary: **Executive Summary:**  DiGiSPICE Technologies Limited is proceeding with the mandatory transfer of equity shares to the Investor Education and Protection Fund (IEPF) for shareholders whose dividends have remained unclaimed for seven consecutive years (since FY 2018-19). Affected shareholders have until October 15, 2026, to claim their outstanding dividends; failure to do so will result in their shares being transferred to the IEPF, requiring a more complex retrieval process directly from the fund. This is a regulatory compliance action, but serves as a crucial warning for specific shareholders to act promptly to retain direct control over their investments.
